sb_prompt: PLEASE DISCUSS AIR POLLUTION.  FIND OUT WHAT SUBSTANCES THE OTHER CALLER THINKS CONTRIBUTE THE MOST TO AIR POLLUTION TODAY.  WHAT CAN INDIVIDUALS OR SOCIETY DO TO IMPROVE AIR QUALITY?
turns: Yeah, I was just calling because I've been breathing in this smog lately, and it really bothers me sometimes.
Yeah, I can't deny that lately the air feels thick, especially down here in the shop where I work. We see that haze every time the big trucks pass by, you know?

Yeah, that haze reminds me of when I lived near the old factory; the smell was so heavy it felt like the air was gone. But honestly, some of this stuff is just fine with me, like the smell of rain after a hot day, even if it does clear the smog out. What do you think is the worst thing coming out of those trucks you mentioned? Is it just soot, or something else?

Soot's probably a big part of it, along with the diesel fumes, but honestly, it's not just the tailpipe; it's the brakes and the tires wearing down, that's what really chokes the air up here. And you know, I've had my mind made up on this years ago, ever since I started working in this shop, but I can't really put my finger on exactly why I feel the way I do about it, maybe it's just seeing my own hands covered in that black dust every day?

That's actually a pretty wild thought, seeing your hands covered like that; I guess I could understand feeling guilty about it, even though my part in it is just living here. But yeah, the brake dust is real, isn't it? Doesn't anyone just quit and move somewhere else to avoid it?
It's not really about quitting, man; it's just that we're stuck here, and honestly, I think a lot of the big companies are the real problem, not just the drivers.
Yeah, I get that; it's not exactly my fault living here, but honestly, some of these companies just keep dumping waste into the air and nobody seems to do anything about it, which is frustrating.
Yeah, I guess you're right, it is frustrating, but I think if people started buying electric cars instead of gas ones, maybe the companies would have to clean up their act to keep selling.
Yeah, that's a fair point about the electric cars, but honestly, switching that many of them out isn't going to happen overnight for folks just trying to pay the bills.
I guess people can try to walk more or ride a bike sometimes, but honestly, most of us just need to get from A to B and the bus takes forever.
Yeah, walking is great if you're young, but my knees aren't exactly built for that commute anymore.
Yeah, the bus is a nightmare, and besides, they're always making us wait forever while the buses sit empty.
Exactly, waiting forever is just asking for trouble when you're running late for work.
Yeah, if they fixed the bus lines we'd actually leave our cars at home sometimes.
Yeah, if the bus was reliable I'd probably try it, but I've seen a few of them break down in the rain and leave people stranded on the street.
Man, that's exactly why I stopped taking the bus when they stopped fixing the fleet, just gotta go back to the shop.
Yeah, I hear you about the breakdowns, but honestly, if I had to spend half my day waiting for a bus that might not even show up, I'd be late for my audits and getting yelled at by my boss.
Yeah, I get the boss yelling part, but honestly, walking is my only option these days since my car broke down again last week.
Well, at least when I walk to the grocery store I don't have to smell my own grease, but I guess I'm just going to stick to the car until it gets fixed.
Yeah, but at least you don't have to deal with the fumes in the shop every single day like I do.
That's true, it's a relief to leave the shop behind, but I guess I'm just stuck with the car until you get it fixed.
Yeah, I mean, you're stuck with the fumes there too, just different ones, but at least you don't have to breathe in the oil and coolant while you're fixing things.
Yeah, you're probably right about that, though it's weird how we all just take it for granted until someone gets sick.
Yeah, that's the scary part, isn't it? We just keep breathing it in until something actually breaks.
Yeah, that's probably what scares me the most, just wondering when I'm going to start coughing up that same black dust you've got in your hands.
Yeah, exactly... I just hope my lungs hold out a little longer than yours.
Yeah, I guess I should stop being so complacent and maybe just wear a mask when I drive by, even if it feels ridiculous doing it in the middle of a parking lot.
Yeah, man, you might want to grab that mask before you drive past the highway this afternoon.
Yeah, I think I'll grab one of those N95s from the office, at least for the commute.
Yeah, might be worth it if you're going right past the exit ramp.
Yeah, I think I'll pick one up tomorrow, hopefully it won't feel like wearing a suit of armor.
Yeah, I'll grab one of those too, just in case the traffic is heavy this time tomorrow.
Yeah, maybe it'll help, but I just hope it doesn't feel like I'm wearing a suit of armor while I'm stuck in that traffic.
Yeah, suit of armor... man, I'll probably just throw away the box and stick to the shop mask, but at least you'll be breathing better than me.
Yeah, suits of armor are heavy, but I'd rather carry the weight than choke to death on black dust.
Yeah, honestly, the mask doesn't feel too bad once you get used to it.
Yeah, once you get used to it, it feels pretty normal, even if it is kinda awkward looking at other people.
Yeah, maybe it's just the shape of it that makes it feel so stiff, but I'll give it a try if I have to.
Yeah, maybe I'll just bring one in tomorrow instead of waiting for the mail order to arrive.
